description: This file defines the Dispatcher class in the Slim framework, responsible for routing HTTP requests by creating and managing route dispatchers, and providing methods to dispatch requests and get allowed methods.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Implements routing dispatcher in Slim framework, manages route dispatcher creation, caching, and request dispatching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dispatcher with a route collector.

methods.name: createDispatcher
methods.description: Creates and returns a FastRoute dispatcher, utilizing caching if available.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an HTTP request based on method and URI, returning routing results.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns allowed HTTP methods for a given URI.
